## Overview

GM-facing document capturing race origin decisions, Covenant experiments, and the gods' false creation claims.

---

## Design Rationale

Race origins tied to divine deception. Gods claim ownership over specific races to control worship. Truth: Originals created all mortals; Covenant accidentally created three more through experiments; gods lie about their role.

## Key Decisions

### Origins
- All standard races created by Originals (A, B, C)
- Half-Elves/Half-Orcs: natural interbreeding
- Drow, Shadow Elves, Tieflings: Covenant experiments (demonic tissue grafts)

### Covenant Experiments
Started on elves (Drow/Shadow Elves), moved to humans (Tieflings). Unintended byproducts of Project Genesis — not intentional race creation.

### Project Genesis
Centuries-spanning experiment to create perfect vessel for Khar'zul. Tieflings showed greatest resistance. Culmination: Balor Skallfang. His mother was final subject; she betrayed Covenant, fled with baby and blade.

### Gods' Race Deception
Each god falsely claims to have created a specific race. Major source of divine control. Mapping deferred until gods have proper names.

### Why Drow Revere Lolth
Lolth didn't create them — took interest after they fled to Underdark. Their traits aligned with her domains (cunning, hierarchy, ruthlessness).

### Why Shadow Elves Revere Raven Queen
She didn't create them — took interest after they claimed Shadowfell. Their shadow attunement aligned with her domain.

---

## Implications
Covenant as accidental race-creators adds moral complexity. Every church built on lie. Tieflings uniquely connected to campaign's central plot. Drow/Shadow Elf worship is genuine spiritual choice.

## Open Questions
Deception map (which god claims which race), why Lolth/Raven Queen took interest, Covenant as part of larger evil council, source of demonic tissue used in experiments.
